hook: This is a very short entry about a vintage Portuguese edition of Monopoly whose games ripple out into real-world property markets. The setup takes a paragraph, and the payoff is a brief audio log of three D-class playing a test game. It is best read in one go, without peeking at the end.
whyItMatters:
3128 is a compact joke article that trusts the reader to connect the dots. The description mentions the 2007 subprime mortgage crisis only as the point after which market-manipulation tests stopped, and lets that timing do the talking.

The structure is also economical: the containment procedures already mention a missing person of interest and a ban on testing, so the log at the bottom quietly answers questions the top of the page raised.
thingsToNotice: The losing player, already crushed by a rival holding six full monopolies, draws a Chance card, knocks, says she is going to use it, and then simply walks out through a door that opens and closes on the recording. She becomes PoI-3128-1, an MTF nicknamed "Damn Feds" is assigned to hunt her alongside the police, and the inventory note reveals the card she used was a Get Out Of Jail Free card. The same note says several other pieces are missing too, and leaving that unexplained is what keeps the ending open.
